mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in a month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) exceeding 0.5% in one month indicate broad-based demand weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as recession risks rise.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline > 0.5% in a month, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 102.0 indicates easing supply chain bottlenecks, boosting corporate margins and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 102.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising 3-month trend in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) compresses unemployment and supports consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS 3-month change is positive, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly core inflation increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals accelerating price pressures, prompting monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises > 0.2pp in a month, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and core inflation (CPIAUCSL) above their 12-month moving averages indicate monetary tightening amid inflation, compressing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both above 12-month moving average
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL are above their 12-month moving averages, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Robust demand conditions defined by RSAFS exceeding 450,000 million dollars and HOUST exceeding 1,100 thousand units support corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS > 450000 and HOUST > 1100, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
